Bulk Chai Masala Powder for Wholesale and Export

Chai masala powder is a ready-made blend of warming spices used to make Indian-style spiced tea. Tradenest Naturals is a bulk chai masala powder supplier India businesses and overseas importers can rely on for a consistent blend, flexible packing and export support. We supply wholesale chai masala powder to beverage companies, cafés, restaurants, hotels, distributors, private label brands and food manufacturers. As a chai masala powder exporter, we handle both standard and customised orders. Buyers order chai masala powder in bulk for foodservice, retail packing, instant beverage mixes and contract manufacturing. We can also build a recipe around your market, with your own spice strength, pack sizes and label format. Ask Tradenest Naturals for a sample, a technical call or the current chai masala powder wholesale price. Tell us your target market, quantity, packaging format and specification, and we will send a practical quotation.

Product Overview

Chai Masala Powder is a fine milled spice blend made for milk tea and other spiced tea drinks. A typical blend contains ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, clove, black pepper and other complementary spices. The final recipe can change with regional taste, the application and the customer's preference. Our standard profile has a warm aroma, a gentle natural sweetness from the spices and a balanced heat. We can make it milder or stronger for different chai styles. We can also lift particular notes, such as more cardamom, ginger, pepper or cinnamon.
  • Suitable for hot milk tea and black tea.
  • Made for commercial kitchens and beverage production.
  • Available for retail, foodservice and industrial use.
  • Produced with controlled grinding, blending and sieving.
  • Supplied with batch identification and a product specification sheet.

Ingredients and Formulation

The standard blend contains ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, clove and black pepper. The exact ratio follows the customer specification once approved. Additions such as fennel, nutmeg, star anise or other sweet spice notes can be discussed. We use food-grade spices that are carefully selected for aroma, colour and flavour and sourced from trusted growers and suppliers. The standard product has no fillers. If you need a particular allergen declaration, dietary statement or restricted-ingredient profile, our team reviews it before production. Chai masala powder manufacturer requirements often differ from one market to another. For that reason, Tradenest Naturals confirms the recipe, particle size, packaging and documents before starting a commercial batch. This keeps repeat orders close to the approved sample.

Manufacturing and Processing

Processing covers raw material inspection, cleaning, controlled grinding, blending and sieving. We first check incoming spices for appearance, aroma and general quality. Each ingredient is then ground to the agreed particle size and blended according to the approved formulation. After blending, the powder is sieved to improve uniformity and remove oversized particles. Handling conditions are controlled to limit exposure to moisture, foreign matter and cross-contact. The finished blend is packed in suitable food-grade packaging and given batch details for traceability. For private label and OEM projects, we can help with recipe development, label coordination, pack selection and production planning. Customers can choose the standard product or work with us as a custom chai masala powder supplier for a specific market.

Typical Technical Specifications

These are typical commercial values. Final specifications depend on the agreed formulation and the destination market. We confirm the product specification before the order is approved.
  • Processing: Fine milled spice blend.
  • Mesh size: 60-80 mesh.
  • Moisture content: Not more than 8%.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing brown to reddish-brown spice powder.
  • Flavour: Warm, aromatic, spicy and balanced.
  • Foreign matter: Controlled through inspection and sieving.
  • Packaging: Food-grade, moisture-resistant and tamper-evident formats.
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. If you need extra parameters checked for your market, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Quality and Compliance Support

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We follow documented hygiene practices, batch traceability, raw material inspection, moisture control and in-house quality checks. We do not claim certifications beyond these, so please raise any specific document needs during the quotation stage. Documents depend on the order, the destination and the customer. We can provide the product specification sheet, allergen information, the ingredient declaration, packing details and export documents. Customer visits and third-party testing can also be discussed where commercially practical. Importers should confirm local rules before placing an order. These can include labelling language, permitted ingredients, residue limits or dietary declarations. Our export team prepares the agreed documents before dispatch.

Applications

Chai masala powder works in a wide range of drinks and foods. It gives a recognisable spiced tea character without handling several whole spices for every serving. Commercial users get faster preparation and a more consistent cup.
  • Masala chai served in cafés, restaurants, hotels and QSR outlets.
  • Instant chai and spiced tea premixes.
  • Milk tea, black tea and iced tea formulations.
  • Tea bags, sachets and single-serve beverage kits.
  • Ready-to-drink tea and beverage concentrate development.
  • Bakery, dessert, confectionery and seasonal flavour applications.
  • Private label retail spice and beverage products.
  • Cloud kitchen and catering beverage service.

Buyer Value

Buying in bulk helps professional buyers manage ingredient costs and cut down repeat purchasing work. A consistent blend also means the same taste across outlets, production runs and retail packs. And a single powder saves time compared with measuring out several whole spices.
  • Consistent flavour for repeat commercial recipes.
  • Efficient handling for high-volume beverage preparation.
  • 12 month shelf life when stored sealed and dry.
  • Flexible pack sizes for sampling, foodservice and wholesale use.
  • Custom recipe support for regional and private label markets.
  • Export-ready packing and documentation support.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We offer 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg formats. Bulk bags and custom export packing are available for larger orders. Formats include stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, laminated inner bags and private label packs. Packaging is food-grade and moisture-resistant, chosen to suit the order size and shipping method. Each pack can carry the product name, ingredient statement, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions and other required details. Shelf life is 12 months from manufacture when the product is unopened and stored correctly. Keep the powder in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity and strong odours. Close the pack after each use to keep the aroma.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Samples

What is the minimum order quantity for bulk chai masala powder supplier India buyers? The MOQ for standard bulk chai masala powder is 5 Kg. Private label or custom OEM projects may need a larger quantity because of artwork, pack type and blending schedule. Lead time depends on formulation approval, packaging confirmation, printed packaging, any testing you request and the export documents involved. We confirm the timeline in the commercial quotation. To request a sample or quote, send us your quantity, application, packaging size, destination country and label needs. We will reply with availability, sample options, an estimated chai masala powder wholesale price and documentation details.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals acts as both a chai masala powder supplier and a manufacturing partner. We handle wholesale supply, export orders, private label packing and custom formulation. Our team puts clear communication, practical specifications and batch consistency first. We also grind, blend and sieve other spices and seasonings, and offer private label packing across our range. Buyers can therefore build a wider product line with one B2B partner.

Frequently Asked Questions

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI licensed and IEC registered. We follow raw material inspection, batch traceability, moisture control and documented processing procedures. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the typical specifications?

The standard blend is fine milled to 60-80 mesh with moisture not more than 8%. The recipe follows the approved customer specification.

Can you supply private label chai masala?

Yes. We offer custom formulations, retail packing, private label artwork coordination and export packaging. Quantities above the 5 Kg MOQ may apply for some projects.

How can I receive the current wholesale price?

Send your quantity, destination, packaging and formulation preference. We will prepare a quotation based on the confirmed requirement.
